quotes.text: We must do what has never been done before to get ahead of AI technology and define how it is integrated into our job spaces.
quotes.editor_note: From McCants' signed campaign platform blog post, a complete verbatim sentence (not a heading or bullet fragment — his site's other sections, including healthcare, are written as sentence fragments with no verb and are NOT usable, which is why he isn't staged on more topics this pass). A forward-looking commitment to proactive AI/workforce regulation, in contrast to a reactive approach. His only existing DB quote (healthcare) is a known heading fragment, not a real quote, and should not be counted as coverage; no verbatim replacement for healthcare was found on his site or elsewhere despite a dedicated search.
